items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: making the record with Matt Pierson, “Lovers and Dreamers and Me” we did tons of pop repertoire

ctx.x: Well do you have people telling you, “Oh listen, Jane, just go up in a more pop vein a little bit, try some of these pop tunes and it’ll pay off”?

Yeah I’ve been told that a lot, and luckily I really love pop tunes, you know making the record with Matt Pierson, “Lovers and Dreamers and Me” we did tons of pop repertoire and it was really fun, it was really fun, but I couldn’t really play it live. You know, making “Surrender” with Jorge Calandrelli we did sort of Brazilian stuff with a Brazilian pop feel, a lot of ballads and stuff like that, and it was really fun. That record we could play more live, because at the time I had a guitarist and a saxophone…
That sounds like a good title for your next record, “it had to be me.”
